quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa and Goran Dragic's early days in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: we both didn't know how to speak English
quotes.quote: The early days for me and Goran, it was unforgivable because we both didn't know how to speak English. But we used to understand each other some way, somehow, on the floor and outside the floor. We used to hang out together, we used to go to dinner, we used to go to clubs. Because we are international, there is something about international players that is different than American players, so we have a better connection. I don't know how to explain, but we had a big-time flow.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the ease of international players adapting to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: guys from Europe and international, they pick it up easily the things on basketball
quotes.quote: I say to the young generation today that guys from Europe and international, they pick it up easily the things on basketball. I don't know if it's because the reason that the league in international is different than America. In America, you only in school, but when you are international, you go level of clubs. It's just different for my culture, and I'm sure it was for Goran.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on Goran Dragic's patience early in his career
quotes.excerpt: the most important point for Goran is that he was really patient
quotes.quote: The most important point for Goran, and I really observed that, is that he was really patient. He went through a time that he thought he was never going to have his time, never going to have his opportunity. We had so many vets on the team that it was kind of hard. But I knew the chances and the opportunity would come because he was every day in the gym. Once he got that chance, the more that he got chances and more minutes, Mike D'Antoni and all the coaches and front office, they start giving more opportunities and more minutes. And then when he figured it out, it was tough to shut it down.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on choosing basketball over soccer in Brazil
quotes.excerpt: I decided to choose a different sport, which my brother used to play basketball
quotes.quote: In Brazil, everybody wants to play soccer because it's the number one, number two, and number three sport. That was my goal, to be a soccer player. But at the same time, because it's in Brazil and everybody wants to play soccer, I decided to choose a different sport, which my brother used to play basketball, and I decided to follow basketball and see if I would fall in love.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on overcoming doubts about his size
quotes.excerpt: no one kind of believed that I was going to be a good basketball player
quotes.quote: No one kind of believed that I was going to be a good basketball player for my height, and I was very, very skinny. That was like a gasoline for me to encourage myself, not only myself, but with my family. I used as much gas I could to keep encouraging myself to work and work and work, so I can achieve where I wanted to go as I believe as a kid.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on his first selection for the Brazilian national team
quotes.excerpt: I got my first selection for the national team in Indianapolis
quotes.quote: When I was 16 years old, I got my first selection for the national team in Indianapolis, which was the World Championship for basketball. A year before Nene came to the draft, Nene said that I would be the next one. The national team helped me out, it gave me the flash for the scouting people and the NBA. But I think to be honest, once Nene went in and he did a really good job on the first year, that opened up the door for the Brazilian players.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the 2003 NBA Draft
quotes.excerpt: I went to New York and I sit where the fans stay
quotes.quote: I went to New York and I sit where the fans stay. I was on the draft, but I didn't believe that I was going to be picked up. I used to hate Carlos Delfino, he was from Argentina, and he was sitting right beside me. I said, 'He's going to be picked up before me.' So it went through so much in my mind at that moment. Once I was selected, Carlos was selected before me, he was number 24. I was number 28 and I was drafted by the San Antonio Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on proving people wrong about his potential
quotes.excerpt: this is to prove to people that nothing is impossible
quotes.quote: I literally said in an interview that I gave, 'This is to prove to people that nothing is impossible,' which a lot of people made impossible for me just because my size, because I was skinny. There's too many players like him in the States, blah, blah, blah. So it came through my dream and the promise that I made to my mama when I was a little kid: 'Mama, one day I will be in the NBA and I'm going to be able to help, and we're going to change our lives.' And it happened.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the importance of speed in his game
quotes.excerpt: there's no reason for me to run without or chasing for something
quotes.quote: There's no reason for me to run without or chasing for something, but when I have the ball, I would throw, I have a reason to run the fast, you know? So that was my thing. And it was using that since I was a little kid, and when I kind of figured out the situation how to play the NBA games, and I kind of transition the way I used to play in Brazil to the way that when Steve Nash came and changed how basketball supposed to be, then I said, 'Okay, this is going to be easy because this is what I most love to do, it's run.' I got the passer, so I mean, that's when the pistol action worked with Goran.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the difficulty of guarding left-handed players
quotes.excerpt: it's kind of like Manu Ginobili, he was unguardable
quotes.quote: It's kind of like Manu Ginobili, he was unguardable, and so Goran was in the same level, especially when he became like a star, starting in teams, he was unguardable. So that's when my name came up, and it was one of the announcers in the Phoenix Suns that gave me that name, the Brazilian Blur, when Nash came and he had the transition to change the running gun, that's when they put up that name and it's still until today.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on his sponsorship with Warner Bros
quotes.excerpt: I got sponsorships from Warner Bros after they gave that and they brought back the Road Runner
quotes.quote: I got sponsorships from Warner Bros after they gave that and they brought back the Road Runner. Yes, and then they also did it like because San Antonio Spurs has the the Coyote, and so every time we would go to the playoff, they would make the Coyote running chasing me, the Road Runner, you know? So it was it was kind of fun, it was a good time.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the physical demands of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: when I first came to the Phoenix Suns, I thought I was going to live the same way
quotes.quote: When I first came to the Phoenix Suns, I thought I was going to live the same way I live in Brazil. I used to go to practice riding my bike, doing my things, like regular, we simple. But Arizona is fucking hot, man. It's hot than a motherfucker. So I couldn't done that, you know? I did it a couple times, but, you know, so the transition for me to understand, you know, like the two practice a day, you know, like how many hours we will be practicing on the training camp, you know, I wasn't used to that.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the influence of Steve Nash on his game
quotes.excerpt: it was more so from Steve Nash than Mike D'Antoni
quotes.quote: When he introduced that style of a game, and believe it or not, I think it was more so from Steve Nash than Mike D'Antoni. Mike kind of like he adjusted for us and Steve took over. And we just follow Steve, you know? And to me, to be honest, for my career, my journey with the Phoenix Suns, it was easier for me. It made easier basketball for me.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on Steve Nash's coaching advice
quotes.excerpt: Steve used to tell me, 'Don't try to be like me, you know? Just be you.'
quotes.quote: Steve used to tell me, 'Don't try to be like me, you know? Just be you.' I'm sure he told you that. I always tried to make the game happen in the same way he did it, but it's impossible, you know, like the way he played. You have to be you. Exactly, and he always say, 'Just be you, LB. Don't worry about it. Just go out there and play and have fun.' You don't have to be like me. Just do what you do.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the importance of sleep and avoiding alcohol
quotes.excerpt: the hours to sleep is the most important in your body
quotes.quote: The hours to sleep is the most important in your body, you know? You got to have that eight hours, you have to. The other thing that helps me too, I don't drink. I been around with so many players that, you know, drink a lot, a lot. I think me and Goran, we be with some players. He retired now. Listen, listen, in my defense, when I signed my first contract, I was 15. I was 15. So I was in a locker room with the grown-ass men, they were smoking, they were drinking. I was like, 'Whoa,' you know? That was part of life.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on the necessity of playing for the national team
quotes.excerpt: I played 22 years with the national team
quotes.quote: I played 22 years with the national team. So, so, like right now the national team is different, but before, in my years, in my time, we would stay two months training, practice two a day. After you go to the playoffs, yeah, that's that's too much. You know, so, so, I remember one time when I saw Travis Diener, I didn't know he was the Dominic, and I saw one time him in the national team, he went to the to the to the national team and he said, 'I will never play to the national team again.' I said, 'Why?' 'I don't got power to go back to the NBA.'

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on his transition from player to coach
quotes.excerpt: it was tough because every time I would jump to do a drills with the players
quotes.quote: It was tough because every time I would jump to do a drills with the players, I'm talking about the beginning, I would think that I could still play. And I made I made could have, you know, but I couldn't. You know? But you know, I think the same thing. But the reason it's that, I'm saying like my first year, you know, my first years, I was in really good shape. I recently retired in Brazil and Stevie brought me here, so I was feeling good.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on Steve Nash's desire to have him as a player
quotes.excerpt: when it was a COVID, Stevie wanted to translate me, wanted to put me as a player again
quotes.quote: When it was a COVID, Stevie wanted to translate me, wanted to put me as a player again because I was the best player like on the pickup, I was the best player. You know, so he wanted to bring me as a player. But that that never happened. So what I did, you know, to try to shut it down, I made myself a transition to a big three, which it really helped me out.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa on his current team and coaching role
quotes.excerpt: my team now is is tough is me, Amir Johnson, Montrezl Harrell, this summer, yeah, yeah
quotes.quote: My team now is is tough is me, Amir Johnson, Montrezl Harrell, this summer, yeah, yeah. Montrezl Harrell, Wesley Johnson, and Brandin Podziemski. To this year is is is a good team, but I'm going to be on the bench, you know? I will be a coach, you'll be a coach. You know, so, uh, but it was tough for me to turn it down that key, you know, always thinking that I could, you know, play, and then the new generation coming, they do some so many crazy things that you always think that you can you can play.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Neymar's role change for the Brazilian national team
quotes.excerpt: Neymar will have to change his position to facilitate to his teammates.
quotes.quote: I don't know if you guys know, Neymar got the selection. That was the number one thing. Even knowing that he's not in his best that he's supposed to be, I think Neymar will have to change his position to facilitate to his teammates. He's not going to be that guy that he used to, run, explode and do so many skills with the ball. He's not that anymore and he has to understand that.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Neymar's impact on the Brazilian national team
quotes.excerpt: If he does that, because he does bring a lot of attention just for his name.
quotes.quote: Come on the second half and be the facilitate, you know what I'm saying? If he does that, because he does bring a lot of attention just for his name being in the national team, it's like a lot. So we are very, very happy to have Neymar.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Can Vinicius Jr and Raphinha replicate their club form for Brazil?
quotes.excerpt: Could Vini Jr play the same way he play in Madrid? Can Raphinha play the same way?
quotes.quote: Could Vini Jr play the same way he play in Madrid? Can Raphinha play the same way he play in Barcelona? If we have those guys do the things that they do on their team, on their team, we're going to be okay. I'm not saying we're going to be a champion because there's there's Spain, look at France, look at Germany.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: The depth of talent on the French national team
quotes.excerpt: Did you see how many players, good players that's out of the the national team.
quotes.quote: But look at France, man. Did you see how many players, good players that's out of the the national team. They could they could fill three teams if they wanted to.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Neymar's return to the Brazilian national team
quotes.excerpt: I'm happy that Neymar got back to the to the national team.
quotes.quote: I'm happy that Neymar got back to the to the national team. Hopefully he's going to open up the other guys' vision to be able to play like they play in their teams, and we're going to be okay. Also, if we get a little luck with the match ups, the match, it will help.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Croatia's success in the World Cup
quotes.excerpt: I remember when Croatia, they didn't have a great team, man, on the world. They got third place.
quotes.quote: I remember when Croatia, they didn't have a great team, man, on the world. They got third place.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa's upcoming travel plans for games
quotes.excerpt: We start in Philadelphia, then New York, and then Miami. I'm playing to go all of them.
quotes.quote: We start in Philadelphia, then New York, and then Miami. I'm playing to go all of them.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa's experience playing against the Magic
quotes.excerpt: Yeah, we played the Magic. It was during the season. Neymar was there too.
quotes.quote: Yeah, we played the Magic. It was during the season. Neymar was there too.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayrton Senna's driving style
quotes.excerpt: Before, Goran used to be scare of everything. He would drive so slow.
quotes.quote: Before, Goran used to be scare of everything. He would drive so slow, but so slowly slow that you have no idea. Now he's getting ticket. You see how things change?

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Neymar's physical condition and recovery
quotes.excerpt: A lot of people being giving a lot of hard time and the reason why is because he's not in shape.
quotes.quote: A lot of people being giving a lot of hard time and the reason why is because he's not in shape, he's not like recover from his knee. And the the biggest thing for Ney is that he has all the access to be better in shape, to to recover himself. All the machines that you can think he has in his house. So he got everything. He just don't do it.

quotes.speaker: Leandro Barbosa
quotes.summary_phrase: Leandro Barbosa's reaction to his mother's death
quotes.excerpt: It was when my mama passed away. I didn't want to come back to the Suns.
quotes.quote: It was when my mama passed away. I didn't want to come back to the Suns. I had a a hard time. I don't think you Goran, you was there. I was 24 years old. I had a big time hard time with the the front office in coming back after my mama passed away, you know. So it was I thought that it was done after I lost her. I feel empty, you know.
